Class MoleculeSnapshot

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeSnapshot
public final class MoleculeSnapshot extends Object
Reads molecule data as it existed when you requested it, together with the source and revision number.

Choose startup registrations, the active server's definitions, or the client's displayed models explicitly. The client may include local resource-pack overrides, so use the server source for server decisions. A world load or later reload does not change which source this object represents; request a new snapshot for newer data. Item/fluid matching uses this retained view and preserves metadata, NBT and container matching rules.
